limitations: One request per setting, ordered 8 then 4; no repetitions or randomized order.
Different model load state, prompt caching and host conditions may affect timings.
Provider decoding time is reported separately from load and prefill; total latency is not attributed only to threads.
A later complete investigation must verify schema, citations, evidence gates and latency before changing worker configuration.
No application source, global CPU/GPU/VM settings or service configuration is changed.

interpretation.recommendation: Four threads materially improved decoding in this single ordered pair. Run a later complete investigation with an explicit four-thread option and all evidence/schema/latency checks before deciding whether to configure the worker. Do not generalize this ratio as a benchmark speedup.
